basis: Standard first-party API-equivalent estimates, not subscription charges, provider-reported spending or invoices. No batch, flex, priority, contributor-tier, data-residency, regional or negotiated adjustments. Claude Haiku 5.5 is priced per request: a request whose prompt, counting input, cache read and cache write tokens, is over 100,000 tokens pays the above rates for the whole request, output included; a prompt of exactly 100,000 tokens pays the base rates. Gemini 4 Argon is paid-tier only, has no prompt-size tier and one input rate for every modality; output includes thinking tokens, and cacheRead is the context caching price (implicit caching only, so no cache-write or storage price). Its base rates apply through 2026-11-30 and each scheduledRates entry from its date; the page names no time zone, so the change applies by the usage's UTC day. Earlier evidence files are retained unchanged.
